headline: First 100% Effective HIV Prevention Drug Approved Globally
meta_description: A new HIV prevention drug requiring just two shots yearly has been approved and will reach 120 lower-income countries royalty-free.
summary_short: Just two shots a year now offer complete protection against HIV. A royalty-free version ensures access across 120 lower-income countries.
body:
A groundbreaking HIV prevention drug with 100% effectiveness has been approved and is rolling out globally. The treatment requires only two shots per year—a dramatic shift in how the disease that has ravaged the world for 44 years can now be prevented.

The approval marks a turning point in the fight against a virus that still infects 1.3 million new people annually. To ensure equitable access, a royalty-free version of the drug will be provided to 120 lower-income countries, removing financial barriers that have long kept life-saving treatments out of reach for those who need them most.

This combination of scientific breakthrough and commitment to global equity offers genuine hope to communities most affected by HIV.
quick_facts: Two shots per year provide 100% HIV prevention
Targets 1.3 million new infections annually worldwide
Addresses disease ravaging world for 44 years
